title: PROFINET: Implement first version of PN-SXP dissector
description:
This pull request introduces the first version of a dissector for PROFINET Service eXchange Protocol frames according to the new PROFINET specification version 2.5.

The frames can be transported via Layer 2 (PN-RTA) and Layer 3 (TCP). The dissector is registered for both paths, including heuristics to check for SXP frames outside the normal path e.g. with a different (ephemeral) TCP port. I have verified the implementation by viewing respective network captures of SXP via RTA and SXP via TCP.

It lacks some detailed service information, error handling and could be more verbose with expert info. More work on this is being done and will be merged back with subsequent pull requests.

This is my first ever PR to Wireshark, the dissector implementation is AI-assisted (GH Copilot).
